posts.title: Stockholm to Mariehamn Ferry Viking Grace
posts.description: The author reflects on a day trip from Stockholm to the Åland Isles, highlighting the affordability of tickets on Viking Line and the ferry’s focus on entertainment and duty-free shopping. They describe boarding as chaotic and the ship's indoor seating policies as restrictive. posts.title: Northern (De-)Lights in Swedish Lappland
posts.description: Abisko in Swedish Lappland is a very accessible place, as it is well beyond the Arctic Circle. There are regular and night trains that use the tracks of the famous Malmbanan (Ore Line) from Kiruna to Narvik.

posts.title: A Day on the Kiel Canal (Nord-Ostsee-Kanal NOK)
posts.description: Enjoying a historic paddle steamer trip on the Kiel Canal, featuring excellent food and insightful commentary.
